Sam (People Ops): Quick draft: manager one-pager for Week 1 with 30/60/90 starter. Please skim and flag gaps. Template link: https://redwood.ok/manager-week1-template :wave:

Sam (People Ops): One-pager bullets:
- Pre-day: confirm laptop + accessories, submit IT ticket, assign buddy, send intro email.
- Day1 AM: org overview (30m), manager 1:1 (30m) - role purpose + communication norms, team intro (30m).
- Day1 PM: accounts + tooling (git, CI, infra access), security quick brief.
- Day2: product & architecture walkthrough, join product sync.
- Day3: local dev + test runner, first onboarding PR assigned.
- Day4: cross-team intros, draft 30/60/90 with manager.
- Day5: ship or pair on small change, feedback + next steps.

Mia (Eng Manager): Looks tight and actionable. Request: include a "First Commit Rubric" (tests, lint, 1 reviewer, green CI or known flaky note). Also add Day1 manager 1:1 prompts (expectations, success signals, feedback cadence).

Alex (DevEx): I'll add starter issues list and auto-apply "starter-pr" label for new-hire accounts. Link to quick local dev guide: https://redwood.ok/dev-quickstart

Raj (IT): Managers: open IT provisioning ticket as soon as offer accepted. Form: https://redwood.ok/it-newhire. Submissions before 10:00 PST on start day get same-day provisioning. For VPN/KMS include manager approval in the ticket.

Sam (People Ops): Adding buddy guidance: pick a peer in squad, 4 weeks pairing, daily 15m stand week1 then twice weekly. We'll include a one-slide "who to ask" cheat sheet (payroll, benefits, oncall, infra, security).

Taylor (new-hire): Thanks everyone! Quick Q: how big should the Day3 onboarding PR be?

Mia (Eng Manager): Hi Taylor  aim for a minimal, useful change: docs fix, small bug, or single-test addition. 1-3 files max. We'll pair if you prefer.

OnboardBot: Calendar: Week1 onboarding block created 10:00-12:00 daily. Manager, buddy, and new hire invited.

Sam (People Ops): Final: I'll publish the one-pager + editable 30/60/90 template and example role fills by EOD. Please comment in the doc for role-specific tweaks. :memo:
